messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu_memory_pressure high on pool=infer-west2a (threshold=85%). 42 alloc failures in 60s. PagerDuty: PD-INC-8421.

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-INC-8421 triggered (high severity) — on-call: alex. Link: https://pd.example/PD-INC-8421

alex: acking in PD. I'm pulling logs now.

alex: quick check — is this localized to a single node or whole pool?

miguel: seeing a spike across 3 hosts in west2a-gpu-01..03. nvml reports rising Vmem usage, processes pinned to GPUs.

jessica: customers reporting elevated 5xx for generate endpoint, looks like 502 from infer-proxy.

sam: routing note: traffic currently split 80% west2a / 20% warm-standby-east. Suggest temporarily shift traffic off west2a to reduce tail latency.

alex: runbook step 0: estimate impact. jessica, can you confirm customer list and number of requests failing?

jessica: quick grep: customer-a, customer-c, 2 internal dev teams. ~120 failed requests in 5m, errors are `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` and `Failed to allocate 1.1 GiB` in logs.

incident-bot: Auto-playbook triggered: recommended mitigations -> 1) drain low-priority sessions on west2a 2) disable prefetch on infer workers 3) scale up dedicated fallback (infer-east-standby).

miguel: running `kubectl get pods -n infer -l pool=infer-west2a -o wide` to get list.

alex: I'm going to evict long-running sessions on west2a. miguel, sam, coordinate traffic shift after I confirm evictions.

ops-runner: command run:
```
kubectl -n infer annotate pods -l pool=infer-west2a eviction=true --overwrite
kubectl -n infer delete pod $(kubectl -n infer get pods -l pool=infer-west2a --field-selector=status.phase=Running -o name | head -n 10)
```

ops-runner: eviction started, evicting 9 pods (lowest priority first).

alex: monitoring logs — one host shows repeated stack:
```
[2026-03-15 12:10:23] runtime: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation at allocator.cu:212
Failed to allocate 1208748544 bytes
nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo: used=24.6GB total=32GB
```

jessica: status page draft: "Partial degradation for generate API in us-west2; retries returning 502/503. Engineers investigating." Want a quick notif?

sam: post it — mark as "investigating" and note possible mitigation in progress.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-INC-8421 escalated to SRE lead (sam) after 5m unacked.

sam: joining bridge. miguel, what did evictions do to pressure?

miguel: after first 9 evictions memory pressure dropped from ~92% to ~78% on evicted hosts but two other hosts ramped up due to rescheduled workloads. We need a short traffic shift AND disable prefetch to avoid prefetch thrash.

alex: disabling prefetch flag on pool config now: `redwoodctl pools set infer-west2a --prefetch=false`

ops-runner: prefetched toggle applied. Confirmed new pods start without prefetch.

jessica: customer impact update: failing requests dropping to ~30 in last minute, but latency for remaining requests increased by 40%.

sam: plan: 1) shift 50% traffic off west2a to east standby 2) continue evictions for longest sessions 3) scale up 4x warm-standby if needed. Agree?

miguel: agree. I'll request scale.

ops-runner: running traffic shift (feature flag):
```
redwoodctl traffic set-split generate --region west2a=50 --region east1=50
```

ops-runner: traffic reroute applied. Monitoring in progress.

alex: PD note: adding escalation info + mitigation steps to incident ticket.

incident-bot: Automated alert: new alloc failures reduced to 6 in 60s post-reroute.

jessica: Prometheus shows error rate for generate from west2a down 65%, overall 5xx down 40%. Good.

sam: still seeing two noisy hosts; recommend cordon + drain them for full remediation. miguel will handle cordon.

miguel: cordon + drain commands:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-west2a-03
kubectl drain gpu-west2a-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

ops-runner: drain in progress for gpu-west2a-03 and gpu-west2a-02.

jessica: customer-a still seeing intermittent failures but reduced. I've escalated to SEs and posted to Status: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/PD-INC-8421

alex: handing off to night oncall (sam) in PD for longer-term remediation and postmortem. My shift ends in 20m.

sam: ack handoff. I'll keep monitoring, verify hosts replaced or reprovisioned tonight, and schedule postmortem with root cause hypotheses (pre-fetch thrash + KVCACHE fragmentation).

incident-bot: PD incident PD-INC-8421 acknowledged by sam.

jessica: final customer impact summary for now: ~3 customers affected, ~200 failed requests over incident window, services degraded for ~18 minutes before mitigation.

sam: thanks everyone. next steps: compaction job for kvcache on affected hosts overnight, follow-up runbook updates to avoid prefetch being enabled with low headroom. I'll open a follow-up ticket. :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup: nice quick work.

ops-runner: closing local remediation loop; will leave traffic split at 50/50 for 30m then reassess.

incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-8421 status -> active -> mitigated (partial).

sam: logging final notes in incident ticket and creating postmortem stub. Good handoff.

jessica: I'll keep status page on watch and update customers if anything changes.

alex: leaving thread — oncall handoff done.

sam: closing the loop here, keeping watch. If allocs spike again I'll re-escalate.

incident-bot: Auto-note: thread closed by sam for handoff; record saved to incidents/PD-INC-8421."
